baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restrictive construction makes their sole hujja the act of saying an imperative, while the signs are already described as recited and clear.
baseline_models.mechanism: Audible sequence, visible disclosure, and a proof expected to prevail are answered not by counter-evidence but by a command to produce another exhibit. The reply therefore transfers the evidential burden from the speakers' position to the reciter's power to comply.

activation_trace.role: The voice-following-voice branch makes the recitation an audible sequence already reaching the addressees.
The manifest-marker branch supplies evidence that is already available for recognition.
The disclosure branch intensifies the signs from mere tokens into something uncovered and evident.
The prevailing-proof branch establishes the evidentiary office that their response is supposed to fill.
The voiced-utterance branch exposes that the alleged proof consists only in producing speech.
The bringing-and-delivery branch turns their speech into a demand that the other side supply the missing exhibit.

changed_reading.before: They answer clear revelation with a resurrection challenge.
changed_reading.after: Their so-called proof is a procedural burden shift: already-present evidence is evaded by requiring the claimant to manufacture a new, controlled demonstration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative to bring the fathers is governed by the condition 'if you are truthful.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The condition moves truth from correspondence between speech and reality to successful performance on demand. The two occurrences of being frame a past record of their argument and a present condition imposed on the addressees, while the requested arrival would make dead ancestry present now.

activation_trace.role: The arrival branch supplies the concrete event by which they elect to test the claim.
The paternal-origin branch identifies the demanded arrivals as the addressees' own generative lineage.
The correspondence branch supplies the ordinary truth criterion that the challenge purports to test.
The fulfillment-in-action branch converts truth into the demanded realization of a promised event.
The occurrence-in-time branch links what their argument was to the condition they impose on what must happen.

changed_reading.before: They request corroboration for a claim about resurrection.
changed_reading.after: They redefine truth as the addressees' ability to make a chosen resurrection event occur immediately, substituting controllable performance for propositional assessment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse places successive recitation beside a demand for the return of a paternal succession.
baseline_models.mechanism: One chain reaches the audience as signs following one another; the counter-demand redirects the argumentative destination toward the fathers who generated and formed the present group. The challenge can therefore be read not only as a demand for resuscitation but as an attempt to make revelation answer to lineage as the preferred chain of authority.

activation_trace.role: The following-in-sequence branch presents recitation as an ordered chain arriving from before.
The generative and formative paternal branch supplies a competing human chain of derivation.
The directed approach toward a magnified object lets the argument be reoriented toward revered predecessors.
The doctrinal-position branch allows their saying to function as allegiance, not merely an isolated sentence.

changed_reading.before: The fathers are simply test cases whose revival would verify resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The fathers also mark a rival succession of authority: the recited chain is required to submit to genealogical precedent before it will be credited.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier sequence distributes signs across the cosmos, creaturely propagation, and rain-driven return of dead earth. Against that field, the demand for the fathers narrows a cumulative material analogy into one bespoke human demonstration and rejects inference unless the final case is staged directly.

activation_trace.role: The bringing branch supplies the demanded one-off delivery that replaces distributed observation.
The paternal-origin branch selects the personally decisive human sample for the challenge.
The manifest-marker branch begins a field of evidence extending beyond the recited wording.
The delivered-downward branch supplies the material input that reaches the earth.
The rain-and-growth branch makes renewed earthly life the observable transformation.
The lifeless-land branch supplies the prior state from which visible renewal proceeds.
The restraint-from-ignorance branch assigns the audience the work of drawing a disciplined inference.

structural_cues: 45:3-5 repeats the sign formula while moving from cosmic scale to organisms to a dead-earth revival sequence.
The focus demand selects a deceased human lineage after those observable cycles have already been presented.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revived dead earth and an explicit call to reason; I supply the analogical arrow from ecological renewal to human restoration. A live alternative is that the challengers accept analogy in principle but demand direct human verification.

changed_reading.before: The challengers ask for the most relevant empirical proof of resurrection.
changed_reading.after: They refuse a distributed evidentiary ecology and stipulate that only a personally selected, fully instantiated human return will count.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truthful recitation is repeatedly heard, yet hearing does not become comprehension or compliance; resolve and self-magnification harden that failure. The later sealing and covering of receptive faculties turns the focus's combination of audible recitation and visible clarity into a diagnostic of blocked reception rather than inadequate signal.

activation_trace.role: The responsive sequence of voices foregrounds the audible channel of the focus evidence.
The uncovering branch foregrounds the focus evidence's visual and cognitive availability.
The ordered-following branch establishes repeated delivery before the focus exchange.
The reality-matching branch marks the mode in which that recitation is supplied.
The understanding-and-compliance branch exposes the gap between acoustic hearing and responsive hearing.
The fixed-resolve branch gives persistence, rather than confusion, a causal role in rejection.
The self-greatness branch supplies the stance that prevents reception from becoming submission.
The secured barrier branch turns failed reception into a closed access condition.
The ocular-seeing branch supplies the faculty to which the focus's manifest evidence would appeal.
The overlying-cover branch blocks the visual channel already emphasized by the focus.

structural_cues: 45:8 explicitly juxtaposes hearing the recitation with behaving as though it had not been heard.
45:23 coordinates closure across receptive faculties immediately before the denial and challenge in 45:24-25.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated hearing, deliberate persistence, and later closure; I infer that this blocked uptake generates the counter-demand in 45:25. The alternative remains that the demand expresses a sincere but unusually strict epistemic threshold.

changed_reading.before: The challenge arises because the offered signs do not meet the audience's standard of clarity.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents abundant, multimodal signal meeting a closed receiver; the challenge is an output of resistance, not a measurement of evidentiary scarcity.

context_deltas.mechanism: Clear directives are followed by division after knowledge, then by the command to follow the appointed way rather than desires. This sharpens the focus's recited succession and paternal succession into competing tracks: the challengers condition acceptance of the first on validation by the second.

activation_trace.role: Sequential following makes the recited signs one track of transmitted guidance.
Paternal generation and formation make ancestry the rival track invoked by the demand.
The separation branch lets clear proofs and the social interval of dispute participate in one differentiating field.
The divergent-paths branch turns disagreement into parties choosing distinct routes after knowledge.
The transgressive-overreach branch supplies a social motive for division despite disclosed knowledge.
The explicit trailing-and-following branch names the choice between two tracks.
The inclining-desire branch supplies the rival force that selects a preferred authority path.

structural_cues: 45:17 moves from supplied clarities to disagreement only after knowledge has arrived.
45:18 pairs a positive following command with a prohibition on following another track.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequential recitation, post-knowledge divergence, explicit following, desire, and fathers; I infer that ancestry can function as an authority chain competing with revelation. The live alternative is that the fathers are only resurrection specimens and carry no normative authority.

changed_reading.before: The demand concerns whether dead individuals can return.
changed_reading.after: The demand also contests which succession governs belief: the recited sequence is made answerable to the challengers' preferred genealogical sequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate pre-focus argument rejects equalizing acquired harm with faithful action across life and death, then grounds individualized recompense in creation with truth. The separating branch of focus clarity now makes the signs discriminative: they disclose distinctions that judgment must preserve, while the demand tries to reduce resurrection to an undifferentiated spectacle on the challengers' timetable.

activation_trace.role: The separation branch lets clarity perform distinction rather than mere brightness.
The prevailing-proof branch places that distinction inside a contested judgment.
The conjectural-reckoning branch supplies the mistaken premise that unlike parties can be treated alike.
The acquired-action branch makes morally charged deeds the basis of differentiation.
The equality branch names the collapse of distinction that the passage rejects.
The adjudication branch identifies the rejected equality as a failure of judgment.
The reality-matching branch grounds creation and its distinctions in a stable order.
The reciprocal-recompense branch supplies the future mechanism that preserves individual difference.

structural_cues: 45:21 explicitly spans both life and death while denying equal outcomes.
45:22 moves from truthful creation to recompense for each self immediately before the denial in 45:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected equality, acquired deeds, truthful creation, and individualized recompense; I infer that resurrection's timing serves discriminating judgment rather than spectacle. The alternative is that 45:25 tests possibility alone and does not engage moral differentiation.

changed_reading.before: Bringing the fathers would be a neutral demonstration that return from death is possible.
changed_reading.after: The requested display strips resurrection from its discriminating judicial function; the surrounding argument presents return as the means by which unequal deeds receive unequal outcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding saying confines life to the present world and assigns destruction to extended time, yet the packet immediately denies its knowledge basis and classifies it as conjecture. The focus's matching restrictive syntax then exposes the challenge as an attempt to make opponents disprove an unsupported claim by producing the fathers.

activation_trace.role: The prevailing-proof branch sets the evidentiary standard their prior claim fails to meet.
The demand for delivery transfers the cost of resolving their uncertainty to the opposing speakers.
The correspondence branch marks the truth standard they challenge while leaving their own account unsupported.
The utterance branch identifies the naturalist account as their own asserted speech.
The extended-time branch supplies the impersonal destroyer posited by their account.
The disclosure-to-a-knower branch marks precisely what their account lacks.
The doubt-and-supposition branch classifies their positive-sounding account as uncertain inference.

structural_cues: 45:24 and 45:25 repeatedly use restrictive constructions, first to state their ontology and then to characterize their only proof.
The challenge in 45:25 is grammatically the continuation of the speakers' unsupported declaration in 45:24.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an asserted time-only account, lack of knowledge, conjecture, and the subsequent demand; I infer a burden-shifting strategy between them. A live alternative is that the demand is an honest attempt to remedy the admitted uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: The challenge is an independent skeptical request for extraordinary evidence.
changed_reading.after: The challenge protects the preceding conjecture by outsourcing its evidentiary deficit: their claim stands unless opponents can stage the requested return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The reply does not comply with the challengers' selected agent or schedule. It names divine agency across life and death and replaces 'bring our fathers now' with a gathering of all persons at an eventful appointed day, preserving fulfillment while rejecting human control of its conditions.

activation_trace.role: The delivery branch encodes the challengers' attempt to assign agency for producing the dead.
Occurrence in time makes the imposed condition depend on when and by whom the event is made present.
Fulfillment in action preserves the issue of realization while allowing its terms to be corrected.
The commanded reply formally answers their prior saying rather than performing its imperative.
The causative-removal-of-life branch assigns death to the same divine agency that the syntax assigns life.
The assembly-at-a-day branch replaces a private production request with universal gathering.
The momentous-day branch supplies the proper event horizon for that gathering.

structural_cues: 45:26 answers immediately with one named subject governing life, death, and gathering.
The demanded subset of fathers is replaced by a second-person plural gathering at the Day of Rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the imperative's assigned agent and the reply's divine subject, three coordinated verbs, and a future gathering; I infer a correction of agency and schedule. The alternative is a simple doctrinal answer without a deliberate procedural reversal.

changed_reading.before: The challenge is rejected because the requested event will not occur.
changed_reading.after: The event is affirmed but re-agenced and rescheduled: fulfillment is not available as a claimant-controlled exhibit, and the challengers will themselves be gathered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challengers demand that absent fathers be produced as evidence, but the tribunal sequence reverses the summons: every community is called to its book, the copied record speaks truth, and the people who heard recitation are charged. Their bare saying is thus converted from a proposed test into one recorded deed within the evidence against them.

activation_trace.role: The bringing branch supplies the original attempt to control who must be produced before whom.
The paternal-line branch identifies the witnesses or exhibits the challengers nominate.
The spoken-utterance branch supplies the act that can itself enter the later record.
The calling-by-speech branch reverses the direction of summons onto every community.
The composed-written-object branch supplies the documentary body that replaces the demanded exhibit.
The speaking-indication branch lets the record provide testimony without the fathers being produced on demand.
The copy-from-record branch supplies continuity between past acts and present testimony.
The repeated-recitation branch returns the focus event as part of the later accusation.
The culpable-offense branch gives the remembered response forensic consequence.

structural_cues: 45:28-29 moves in sequence from communities being called, to books, to a book speaking, to copied deeds.
45:31 repeats the focus's recitation-to-you construction as retrospective accusation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the reversed summons, speaking copied record, deeds, and repeated recitation; I infer that the focus challenge is among the recordable acts and that documentary testimony answers its demand. The alternative is that the book records deeds generally without preserving this utterance specifically.

changed_reading.before: They seek to summon the dead as witnesses against the resurrection claim.
changed_reading.after: The later court summons the challengers, while a speaking record rather than their chosen ancestors bears witness; their challenge becomes evidence about them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus condition equates truth with immediate ancestral arrival. Later, the promise is explicitly reality-matching and the Hour is free of destabilizing doubt, while the speakers confess lack of knowledge, conjecture, and no settled certainty. The dispute therefore concerns whether they may replace an appointed promise with their own verification time and mode.

activation_trace.role: The arrival branch supplies the immediate event selected as their truth criterion.
The fulfillment branch keeps realization live while separating it from the challengers' chosen schedule.
The paired utterances stage the announced proposition and the audience's response to it.
The time-or-place-bounded promise branch gives fulfillment an appointed setting.
The stable correspondence branch explicitly predicates truth of the promise.
The agitated-doubt branch is negated from the Hour even as the speakers remain unsettled.
The knowing branch marks the knowledge the speakers disclaim.
The uncertain-supposition branch defines the weak epistemic state from which they set their test.
The settled-knowledge branch names the condition they deny possessing.

structural_cues: 45:32 directly predicates truth of the promise and immediately names the Hour.
The speakers move from not knowing, to mere conjecture, to absence of certainty in one compressed response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed promise, its truth, the Hour, and the speakers' epistemic admissions; I infer that their focus condition substitutes a self-selected timetable for the promised one. The alternative is that they reject agency or possibility rather than timing.

changed_reading.before: If the promise is true, the fathers should be producible as proof now.
changed_reading.after: Truth includes fulfillment at its appointed event; demanding arrival now is an unauthorized change to the promise's temporal specification, not a neutral test of correspondence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus demands that absent fathers be made visibly present before the signs will count. In the judgment sequence, what instead becomes manifest is the harm of their own acts, what they mocked surrounds them, and the glitter of present life is exposed as deception. The desired object of appearance is replaced by an unwanted one.

activation_trace.role: The manifest-marker branch establishes that signs already operate through appearance and recognition.
The uncovering branch intensifies the challengers' insistence on what must be made evident.
The arrival branch identifies the appearance the challengers try to nominate.
The emergence-into-view branch supplies the later, involuntary manifestation.
The descending-and-enclosing harm branch turns disclosed evidence into unavoidable environment.
The mockery branch links the enclosing outcome to their earlier treatment of the signs.
The repeated manifest-marker branch identifies the very signs whose evidentiary force was trivialized.
The deceptive-glitter branch explains how the immediately visible world displaced trust in less controllable fulfillment.

structural_cues: 45:33 puts emergence first and enclosure second, reversing the challengers' desired sequence of demonstration then decision.
45:35 denies both exit and an opportunity to repair the relation; the final branchless occurrence is used only as this structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a demanded arrival, later manifestation, enclosing consequence, mockery, and deceptive present life; I infer a reversal in the object of appearance. The alternative is that 45:33-35 fulfills judgment generally without intentionally answering the wording of 45:25.

changed_reading.before: The challengers reserve belief until the fathers visibly appear.
changed_reading.after: The passage answers their politics of visibility by making their deeds and consequences appear instead; they do receive disclosure, but not the exhibit they tried to control.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ت ل ل mapping rather than the ordinary recitation root. It remains anchored to the exact focus form and gains a later enacted posture, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant latent echo, never as the lexical meaning of the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus recitation form carries a supplied split-root branch of physically casting down.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant split contributes a physical casting-down image beneath the recitation form.
The kneeling posture later gives bodily realization to the form-distant image.

changed_reading.before: The signs are orally recited upon resistant hearers.
changed_reading.after: As a contained sound-form activation, the recitation that they refuse already foreshadows their being physically brought low in the later assembly.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping under the focus saying. The restrictive syntax independently anchors the sense of evidentiary reduction, but the branch should be rendered as experimental wordplay that sharpens insufficiency, not as a replacement etymology for speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Their hujja is restricted to a bare saying, and the supplied split mapping contributes diminution.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant split contributes smallness and deficiency to the utterance left as their sole proof.
The prevailing-proof branch supplies the full evidentiary measure against which that saying appears reduced.
The prior utterance repeats the same diminished evidentiary mode across the claim and its challenge.

changed_reading.before: Their argument happens to be expressed as speech.
changed_reading.after: The construction leaves their supposed proof materially diminished to speech alone: assertion and challenge form a thin remainder where prevailing evidence was expected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain legal activation of a secondary branch under the ordinary recitation root. It remains anchored because the focus names an argument and the context later supplies individualized settlement, but downstream prose should qualify it as a liability metaphor rather than claim that recitation literally means debt.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A supplied branch under the focus recitation root depicts a right or liability that follows its bearer.

activation_trace.role: The follow-on obligation branch lets recitation deposit a claim that continues with its hearers.
The proof-in-dispute branch turns their demand into an attempted counterclaim against that obligation.
The collection-and-settlement branch supplies a later accounting mechanism for what follows each hearer.

changed_reading.before: Recitation communicates evidence that listeners may accept or reject.
changed_reading.after: As a contained legal metaphor, recitation also creates a claim that follows the hearers; their demand is a counterclaim that does not cancel the eventual settlement.

strongest_changes: The focus challenge became a burden-shifting defense of the unsupported time-only claim in 45:24.
The immediate answer preserved resurrection while correcting both its agent and its timetable: the challengers will be gathered rather than control who is brought.
The tribunal reversed their proposed summons and replaced chosen ancestral exhibits with a speaking copied record that includes their response as accountable action.
The earlier dead-earth sequence changed the demand from a relevant request into refusal of cumulative analogy unless a bespoke human case is staged.
Later manifestation reversed the object of their visibility test: deeds and consequences appeared instead of the fathers they nominated.
summary.what_was_special: The trace repeatedly reversed roles and directions: offered signs became a demanded exhibit, would-be summoners became the summoned, bare speech faced a speaking record, and desired appearance became unwanted disclosure. The packet's split mappings also preserved three qualified latent readings without forcing them into ordinary lexical glosses.
remaining_uncertainties: The fathers may carry ancestral authority as well as serving as resurrection specimens, but the authority reading remains less secure than the empirical challenge.
The ecological revival analogy is strongly sequenced, yet the precise inferential bridge from dead earth to human resurrection is reader-supplied.
The later court and appearance reversals may be deliberate answers to the focus wording or broader thematic correspondences.
The split-root outliers are valid experimental activations only and should not be presented as lexical translations.
